takeaway: NQ futures are flat-to-slightly-red premarket (~29,425) after Monday's +0.8% Nasdaq bounce. The AI bid from Anthropic's S-1 is fading into the FOMC (2-day meeting starts today; hold expected, ~10% hike odds). Iran is the wildcard: Trump says 'decision time' (deal or more strikes), Iran floated a 7-day plan to reopen Hormuz, and a Ras Tanura refinery fire was contained. Brent ~$110, WTI ~$101-102, 10Y ~4.98%, DXY 12-day high, gold back under $4,000. CDNS beat-and-raise (+2.4% pre) keeps semis supported; Amkor's weak guide is a drag.
